# UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Workbench Input and Shortcuts

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the Workbench canvas navigation, selection, cancellation, and keyboard-shortcut requirements.
**Created**: 2026-09-21
**Feature**: Workbench input and shortcut behavior defined in the collaboration UX checklist

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on the supplied Workbench input/shortcut plan and the feature context.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for every navigation input in the proposed interaction model: middle mouse, two-finger trackpad movement, pinch gestures, arrow keys, zoom controls, and reset-view shortcut? [Completeness, Plan §Recommended Shortcut Reference]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for both horizontal and vertical canvas movement, including whether each supported input must support both axes? [Completeness, Plan §Sprint 1]
- [ ] CHK003 Are selection requirements defined for plain item selection, Shift-based additive/toggle selection, empty-background deselection, and active-item state? [Completeness, Plan §Sprint 2]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for all listed shortcut groups: tools, navigation, viewport controls, history, clipboard, deletion, and layer ordering? [Completeness, Plan §Recommended Shortcut Reference]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for cancellation behavior across modals, popups, menus, transient gestures, editors, and the plain canvas? [Completeness, Plan §Task 2.3]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for what remains unchanged after the Hand tool is removed, including node movement, connections, drawing, erasing, context menus, and existing zoom controls? [Completeness, Plan §Sprint 1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is “two-finger trackpad movement” defined distinctly from pinch-in and pinch-out, without relying on an ambiguous phrase such as “trackpad scroll”? [Clarity, Plan §Prerequisites]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the direction semantics for pinch-out zoom-in and pinch-in zoom-out stated unambiguously? [Clarity, Plan §Recommended Shortcut Reference]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the arrow-key pan amount specified as a concrete fixed screen-space step rather than only “a fixed step”? [Ambiguity, Plan §Task 2.2]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the behavior of repeated arrow-key input specified, including whether key repeat is supported and whether it changes history or persistence state? [Clarity, Plan §Task 2.2]
- [ ] CHK011 Is “topmost modal or popup” defined sufficiently to establish which surface owns Escape when multiple transient surfaces are present? [Ambiguity, Plan §Task 2.3]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the distinction between clearing selection and cancelling an active interaction explicitly defined for each Escape state? [Clarity, Plan §Task 2.3]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the platform labels `Ctrl/Cmd`, `+`/`=`, `Delete`/`Backspace`, and `Shift` defined in a way that avoids keyboard-layout ambiguity? [Clarity, Plan §Recommended Shortcut Reference]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Do the middle-mouse pan requirements remain consistent with the requirement that left-button dragging is reserved for selection and node movement? [Consistency, Plan §Sprint 1]
- [ ] CHK015 Do the trackpad pan and pinch-zoom requirements remain consistent with the stated preservation or modification of wheel-zoom behavior? [Conflict, Plan §Overview; Plan §Task 4.1]
- [ ] CHK016 Do Shift multi-selection requirements align with the stated removal of Meta/Control as required multi-selection modifiers? [Consistency, Plan §Task 2.1]
- [ ] CHK017 Do Escape requirements consistently state that viewport zoom and position remain unchanged while selection and transient UI may change? [Consistency, Plan §Recommended Shortcut Reference; Plan §Task 2.3]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the shortcut reference, toolbar/tooltips, and in-product help required to expose the same final bindings and terminology? [Consistency, Plan §Task 2.4; Plan §Task 4.3]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Can successful middle-mouse panning be evaluated objectively in terms of direction, axes, and absence of selection or node movement? [Measurability, Plan §Task 1.3]
- [ ] CHK020 Can successful trackpad translation and pinch zoom be evaluated objectively without requiring a particular browser event implementation? [Measurability, Plan §Task 1.3]
- [ ] CHK021 Can successful selection behavior be evaluated for replacement, additive/toggle selection, and complete background deselection? [Measurability, Plan §Task 2.1]
- [ ] CHK022 Can Escape behavior be evaluated in a defined priority order across menus, modals, transient gestures, editors, and plain-canvas state? [Measurability, Plan §Task 2.3]
- [ ] CHK023 Are viewport-control outcomes specified separately for zoom in, zoom out, fit-to-screen, zoom-to-100%, and reset viewport so “reset” has one unambiguous meaning? [Clarity, Plan §Recommended Shortcut Reference]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 Are primary desktop mouse scenarios defined for selecting, moving nodes, middle-button panning, and right-click menus without competing interpretations? [Coverage, Plan §Sprint 4]
- [ ] CHK025 Are alternate trackpad scenarios defined for two-finger translation, pinch-out, pinch-in, and mixed movement without requiring macOS-specific implementation assumptions? [Coverage, Plan §Task 4.1]
- [ ] CHK026 Are keyboard-focus scenarios defined for the canvas, text inputs, textareas, contenteditable node editors, menus, dialogs, and other focusable controls? [Coverage, Plan §Task 2.2; Plan §Task 2.3]
- [ ] CHK027 Are selection scenarios defined for zero selected items, one selected item, multiple selected items, mixed node types, and stale or unavailable selection state? [Coverage, Plan §Task 2.1]
- [ ] CHK028 Are cancellation scenarios defined for open modal, open popup, open context menu, active drawing or connection gesture, active editor, and no transient UI? [Coverage, Plan §Task 2.3]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for simultaneous or rapidly alternating navigation inputs, such as middle-button movement followed by trackpad or keyboard panning? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for gesture behavior at minimum and maximum zoom boundaries? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements defined for browser or platform environments that do not expose trackpad pinch and translation as distinguishable gesture signals? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements defined for keyboard layouts where `+`, `=`, `[`, or `]` require modifier keys or differ from the documented labels? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK033 Are requirements defined for Escape when a dialog or menu library already owns dismissal and focus restoration? [Edge Case, Plan §Task 2.3]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK034 Are keyboard accessibility requirements defined for reaching and operating every shortcut-controlled canvas action without relying solely on pointer gestures? [Accessibility, Gap]
- [ ] CHK035 Are focus-management requirements defined after Escape closes a modal, popup, menu, or editor? [Accessibility, Plan §Task 2.3]
- [ ] CHK036 Are requirements defined to prevent browser page scrolling or unintended text editing when arrow keys are used for canvas panning? [Accessibility, Plan §Task 2.2]
- [ ] CHK037 Are performance expectations for continuous trackpad panning, pinch zoom, and held-arrow panning specified with measurable responsiveness or frame-budget criteria? [Performance, Gap]
- [ ] CHK038 Are requirements defined for preserving user orientation and avoiding unexpected viewport jumps during navigation and cancellation actions? [UX, Gap]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK039 Is the assumption that the supported canvas library can distinguish middle-button drag, two-finger translation, and pinch zoom documented and validated at the requirements level? [Dependency, Plan §Prerequisites]
- [ ] CHK040 Are browser and operating-system support expectations stated for trackpad gestures, mouse-wheel behavior, keyboard layouts, and modifier conventions? [Dependency, Gap]

## Notes

- This checklist intentionally focuses on Product/UX requirements quality for navigation, selection, cancellation, and shortcuts.
- Modify-node and `Q` requirements are explicitly excluded from this checklist per reviewer scope; they remain in the source plan for a separate requirements review if needed.
- The trackpad review uses a cross-platform baseline: it evaluates intended interaction semantics and fallback requirements without requiring macOS-specific browser event details.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline and link to relevant plan sections when resolving gaps.
